title: Marcus Vinicius's video of the being shown to many
summary: Italo Venturelli tells of Marcus Vinicius's video of the being shown to many, about 1996-2018 at Varginha, Brazil, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.
place_text: Hospital Regional and Marcus Vinicius's house, Varginha, Brazil

tellings.quote: This colleague had the video. He showed it to several people. Many people watched this video at his house on his computer.

at home on his computer? They would come into the room, sit on the sofa. He would sit in front of the computer and maybe a CD or a tape, but I think it was a CD because he would show it repeatedly sometimes.
tellings.difference: Adds that Italo thinks the video was on a CD and was shown again and again.
tellings.link_reason: Marcos Vinícius showing his video of the being to visitors at home on his computer.

as_told.title: Marcos Vinícius showed his alien video on a CD at home

plain: Italo Venturelli, a surgeon connected to the regional hospital in Varginha, Brazil, says a colleague of his, Marcus Vinicius, had a video of a strange being, which Venturelli ties to his hospital's story of operating on an alien in 1996. Venturelli says many people came to his colleague's house, sat on the sofa, and watched it on his computer, he thinks from a CD, shown again and again. If true, it would mean footage of a non-human creature was passed around privately for years.
